jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - Cyber Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, a leading player in the banking sector, is seeking a Cyber Security Program Manager to drive their bank-wide cyber security strategy, with a specific focus on post-quantum cryptography and long-term cryptographic resilience. You will join our client's team as a strategic leader, defining and overseeing a high-impact portfolio of security initiatives, engaging senior stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations and cryptographic standards.
Interested?

If you are ready to shape the future of cyber security in banking and lead our client's transition to quantum-safe architectures, we would be pleased to receive your application.

• Cyber Security Strategy & Portfolio Management - Define the cyber security initiative strategy, translate it into a prioritized portfolio, and oversee cross-dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes

• Roadmap Development & Execution - Develop long-term and short/medium-term roadmaps with clear priorities and budgets, then drive day-to-day delivery, removing impediments and ensuring adherence to master plans

• Post-Quantum Cryptography (Pqc) Knowledge - Apply strong Pqc fundamentals (e.g., lattice-based algorithms, hybrid encryption, NIST standardization) to guide cryptographic modernization and resilience

• Information Security Governance - Lead initiatives aligned with established security frameworks and risk management practices, ensuring compliance with group standards and external guidelines

• Stakeholder & Executive Engagement - Interact regularly with senior management and ExCo, aggregating input and translating complex topics like quantum risk and Pqc transition into clear, actionable memos

• Governance & Policy Contribution - Support policy improvements and the development of quantum-safe data security frameworks in collaboration with relevant teams

• Leadership & Communication - Drive success across disciplines, navigate technical uncertainty, and tailor messaging for both executives and technical teams

• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Break down complex issues such as Pqc migration trade-offs, proactively addressing long-term cryptographic risks and immediate vulnerabilities

• Language Skills - French mandatory (fluent), with professional proficiency in English and Dutch

• Work Arrangement - Hybrid working model based in Brussels

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

• Have a valid Belgian address

jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad
